The full full-stack framework for Rust

Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity. See Learn Topcoat to get started, or the Roadmap for what's coming next.

Early-stage and experimental. Expect breaking changes.

# What makes Topcoat different

# Client reactivity without the boilerplate

Topcoat renders all markup on the server: components can be async and query the database directly, eliminating all the traditional boilerplate needed for a separate API layer. Interactivity does not have to cost a round-trip, though. A $(...) expression is ordinary type-checked Rust that Topcoat evaluates on the server for the initial render and also translates to JavaScript, so it re-runs instantly in the browser. No wasm bundle, no client build step:

repos.description: The batteries-included agent harness.
repos.readme_excerpt:
The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

• Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work

• Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking

• Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local

• Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

• Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows

• Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends

• Context management — summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk

• Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice

• Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall

Everything about UAD-ng (and related stuff) can be found on the Wiki, such as:

• Features of this app

UAD-ng does not collect or transmit any user data. The only external connections are GET requests to GitHub for fetching the package list (crates/uad-core/src/uad_lists.rs) and checking for updates (crates/uad-core/src/update.rs).

Three system signals. One native macOS status icon — in your menu bar or the Dock.

Want to see it in action first? Open statustrio.lingai.net to simulate every icon state in your browser.

Status Trio is a native macOS status app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable icon, shown in the menu bar, in the Dock, or in both. Its popover goes deeper than the icon: a Wi-Fi panel for nearby networks and link details, a Bluetooth panel for paired devices, a Battery Details page, and the audio devices that are playing. It is inspired by the iPhone Duo's combined status bar icon for Wi-Fi, Battery, and Cellular Data, adapted for Mac with Volume instead of Cellular Data.

> Status Trio is an independent project and is not affiliated with Apple.

# Highlights

• One icon, three signals — battery, Wi-Fi, and volume share one icon in the menu bar, the Dock, or both, and a Bluetooth device that is playing can take the middle spot with its own symbol.

# Linux on the ZTE F50 / MU300 and U30 Air

News and new releases are announced on the Telegram channel: t.me/mu300project. Follow it to hear

The ZTE F50 is a pocket 5G router. This project turns it into a small Linux computer: Ubuntu (24.04 or 26.04 LTS) or OpenWrt (plain, or with a control panel for the modem), with SSH, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and its 5G modem working. Android stays on the device, and you can go back to it at any time.

Think of it as a Raspberry Pi that already has a 5G modem, a Wi-Fi access point and 32 GB of storage inside.

The ZTE U30 Air is supported too: the same board and chip with a battery. The installer recognises which one it is talking to; see Supported devices.

Steel.dev is an open-source browser API that makes it easy to build AI apps and agents that interact with the web. Instead of building automation infrastructure from scratch, you can focus on your AI application while Steel handles the complexity.

• Full Browser Control: Uses Puppeteer and CDP for complete control over Chrome instances -- allowing you to connect using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium.

• Session Management: Maintains browser state, cookies, and local storage across requests

• Proxy Support: Built-in proxy chain management for IP rotation

• Extension Support: Load custom Chrome extensions for enhanced functionality

Requires iPhone or iPad, iOS 17 or later.

repos.description: Things to do after installing Fedora 45
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Fedora 45 Post Install Guide

Things to do after installing Fedora 45

# RPM Fusion

• Fedora has disabled the repositories for a lot of free and non-free .rpm packages by default. Follow this if you want to use non-free software like Steam, Discord and some multimedia codecs etc. As a general rule of thumb it is advised to do this to get access to many mainstream useful programs.

• Enable third party repositories by pasting the following into the terminal:

• sudo dnf install https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm

• also while you're at it, install app-stream metadata by:

• sudo dnf install -y rpmfusion-free-appstream-data rpmfusion-nonfree-appstream-data

# Update

• Go into the software center and click on update. Alternatively, you can do:

• sudo dnf -y update

把表格交给 Codex，把可编辑的科研图带回 Origin 理解数据 · 选择表达 · 定制样式 · 检查交付 三步开始 · 看图选模板 · 复制提示词 · 完整教程 · English

我做 EditaPlot，是想少花一些时间反复调图，多留一些时间讨论数据本身。你把表格和想表达的问题告诉 Codex，它会先说明每列的用途，等你确认后，再调用本机 Origin 绘图和检查结果。

它是一个 Codex Skill，不是独立绘图软件。你仍然可以在 Origin 中继续编辑曲线、坐标轴和图例；配色、线宽与版式也可以在已支持的范围内按你的需求调整。

使用前提：Windows 10/11 x64 实体电脑 + Codex + 本机 Origin/OriginPro。 日常使用不需要提前打开 Origin；Mac、Linux、WSL 和虚拟机暂不支持。

# 先看看能画什么

按实际列展示背景、包络和组分，不补造缺失峰。 同时看组间分布和每个观测，而不只看一根柱子。 使用上游已提供的逐样本 SHAP；绘图层不训练模型。 保留全部 900 个源值与行列顺序，不插值、不自动聚类。

这些示例都用合成教学数据，由真实 Origin 生成，不代表实验或临床结论。点击图片可以看原图。

浏览全部 45 条绘图路线 → 荧光 / EEG 研究信号 English gallery

# 开始使用

# 1 / 安装：这段话交给 Codex

不会 GitHub 也没关系，把下面这段话复制给 Codex：

请下载并保留完整仓库（包括 runtime），运行根目录 editaplot.cmd setup 和 doctor。 优先复用已有的 64 位 Python 3.11/3.12；需要安装 Python 时先问我。 不要安装或修改 Origin，不要修改注册表、DCOM，也不要申请管理员权限或控制鼠标。 完成后用中文告诉我环境是否就绪，再让我提供数据。

也可以下载完整 ZIP，完整解压后让 Codex 在该文件夹里安装。不要只复制 skill/editaplot 子目录，它需要仓库中的绘图引擎。

首次运行缺少兼容 Python 时，先按安装指南完成确认与配置。项目依赖只进入本项目环境，不修改全局 Python。

# Battery-Emulator ⚡🔋

# What is Battery Emulator?

Many manufacturers sell home battery systems to enable homeowners to store power collected from the grid, or renewable sources, to use at times when electricity demand is higher. However almost all of these home battery systems charge a high cost for every kilowatt hour (kWh) of capacity you buy.

At the same time, EV manufacturers have been putting high capacity battery packs into their cars, with no firm plan for what should happen to those batteries if the car is damaged in a crash, or reaches the end of its life as a vehicle.

Battery Emulator enables EV battery packs to be repurposed for stationary storage. It acts as a translation layer between the EV battery and the home inverter. This makes it extremely cheap and easy to use large EV batteries in a true plug'n'play fashion!

repos.description: Python Materials Genomics (pymatgen) is a robust materials analysis code that defines classes for structures and molecules with support for many electronic structure codes. It powers the Materials Project.
repos.readme_excerpt:
Pymatgen (Python Materials Genomics) is a robust, open-source Python library for materials analysis.

> The core data objects (Element, Site, Molecule, Structure, Composition, Lattice) and > file I/O for major electronic structure codes now live in the lean [pymatgen-core] package. > Installing pymatgen automatically pulls in pymatgen-core and adds the higher-level > analyses, applications and external integrations described below. If you only need the core > objects and I/O, depend on pymatgen-core directly for a much lighter install.

These are some of the main features provided by this package on top of pymatgen-core:

• The full set of core classes from [pymatgen-core] (Element, Site, Molecule, Structure,

Composition, Lattice) re-exported under the familiar pymatgen.core namespace, plus extensive input/output for VASP, XYZ and many other file formats.

• Powerful analysis tools (pymatgen.analysis), including generation of phase diagrams,

repos.description: Development version of plumed 2
repos.readme_excerpt:
Several branches and tags are stored on the git repository.

Branches named v2.X correspond to release branches.

Master branch may contain non tested features and is not expected to be used by non-developers. It typically contains features that will be available on the next release.

Tags named v2.XbY correspond to beta releases, use it with care. Tags named v2.X.Y correspond to official releases, use the latest available.

In addition, the repository contains a number of other branches related to specific features. Please contact the developers that are committing on those branches before basing your work there, since they might contain temporary work and might be rebased later. For instance, branch testdoc is setup so as to push a test copy of the manual and is often force pushed.

repos.description: Windows 上读取 2.4G 无线外设电量的小工具（纯 ctypes，零第三方依赖）
repos.readme_excerpt:
# 设备电量查看器

Windows 上读取 2.4G 无线外设电量的小工具。纯 ctypes 调系统 DLL，零第三方依赖—— 不用 hidapi、不用 pystray、不用 Pillow、不用 pywin32，装了 Python 就能跑。

# ⚠️ 只支持这两台设备

这不是一个通用工具。协议是逆向我们这两台具体设备得到的——换成别的鼠标或耳机， 大概率一个字节都读不出来（界面会显示「没有可用的读取方式」）。

你的设备不在这两行里？ 别硬改这个仓库，往下看「用 prompt 做一份你自己的」。

# 使用方法

面板里会显示两台设备的电量，默认自动刷新，底部可以改刷新间隔。

• 想摸新设备的协议：python app.py —— 完整调试版，可枚举接口、转储 Feature Report、探测 Report ID、手动标定

# 用 prompt 做一份你自己的

这套东西的价值不在代码，在方法。下面这段 prompt 把我做这个工具的全过程和结论都写进去了， 交给一个能动手的 Agent 就能按你自己的设备重做一份。

> 这不是「写点代码」的活：要枚举本机 HID 接口、抓真实报文、试发命令、爆破 CRC、 > 再到真机上验证——每一步都得实际在这台电脑上跑起来。 > 纯聊天窗口只能给你一段猜出来的代码；能执行命令、能读写文件的 Agent 才调得通。

• 复制下面折叠块里的 prompt（或直接打开 PROMPT.md）

• 贴给一个 Agent：WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy / Cursor / Claude Code 这类都行（关键是要能执行命令、读写文件）

• 换成你的设备：把 prompt 里「要读的两台设备」那一段替换掉。

不知道 VID/PID 就这样查：设备管理器 → 右键设备 → 属性 → 详细信息 → 硬件 Id，

• 让它跑通：Agent 会给出一套初始实现。如果读不到电量，让它用完整版的

「原始探测 + 手动标定」把真实协议摸出来，再把结果补回 prompt 的协议段

prompt 里已经写好了硬性约束、协议模板、7 条会踩的坑和验收标准，照做基本不会返工。

repos.description: Custom integration to monitor and control Marstek Venus, Zendure, Anker Solix, Sessy, Hoymiles batteries in Home Assistant.
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Omnibattery for Home Assistant

Omnibattery is your one stop Home Assistant integration designed to monitor and control pluggable solar batteries, as of today, the following ones are supported:

• Marstek Venus E and C (v2 and v3), Venus D and Venus A via Modbus TCP

• Zendure SolarFlow 4000 Mix Pro, 4000 Mix AC+, 3000 Mix AC+, 2400 AC+, 2400 AC Pro, 1600 AC+, 800 Pro, 800 Plus and 800 (Local API)

• Anker SOLIX Solarbank Max AC and Solarbank 4 E5000 Pro via Modbus TCP (thanks @wouterbouvy!)

• Sessy Home Battery (Looking for testers!!!)

• Hoymiles MS-A2 and HiBattery MQTT models

• Indevolt SolidFlex 1200, 2000, 3000 and 3600, and PowerFlex 1200, 2000 and 3000 (Local HTTP API)

# Key Features

• Mix and match different battery brands: Marstek, Zendure, Anker Solix, Sessy, Hoymiles MQTT, Indevolt and more to come!

• Zero Export/Import PD Controller: Keeps grid exchange near zero using a Proportional-Derivative algorithm.
